headline: Google is adding AI scam checks to Android messages and expanding a feature that ends fake bank calls automatically.
score_reason: Real consumer protection rollout, but a product update with figures from Google itself.
importance_line: Android users face fewer scam texts and spoofed bank calls, but the stronger message protection is off until they switch it on and the block figures come from Google.
summary: BleepingComputer reports that Google is rolling out AI-powered scam defences on Android, including Gemini-based checks of messages from unknown senders in Google Messages and an expanded system that automatically ends calls that a real bank did not place. Google says it has blocked over 3 million fraudulent calls of this kind for two Brazilian banks alone since June, and the cloud-based message protection is off by default.
notes: Full text read. Numbers are Google's own claims.
